prompt.es: Interviene en la asamblea: turno, postura, réplica, pregunta reportada y resumen.

answer.text: May I have the floor, please? I support closing the street on Sundays, because children could play safely. Let me add one more point: children could also walk to school without traffic. Tom argued that the shops would lose customers. I take his point; however, many families would walk to the market, so the shops could sell more. Ana asked whether it would be safe for bikes. That is a fair question, and my answer is yes, as long as the council puts up signs. Instead of closing the street all day, I would suggest closing it from ten to four. To summarize, I propose a trial of three months. If the residents are not convinced, we can vote again.
